meta.name: 3-min gap reversal breakout
meta.summary: When NIFTY opens with a gap, fade the stocks that gapped most in the same direction - but only after a 3-minute candle closes beyond the first 3-minute candle.
rules: 09:15 - NIFTY gap = open vs previous close. Above +0.2% = gap up, below -0.2% = gap down, else flat.
Rank NIFTY 50 stocks by their own opening gap.
Gap up: SHORT the 2 biggest gap-up stocks. Gap down: LONG the 2 biggest gap-down stocks. Flat: SHORT the top 1 and LONG the bottom 1.
Reference candle = first 3-minute candle (09:15-09:18). No trade before 09:18.
LONG when a 3-minute candle closes above the reference high; SHORT when one closes below the reference low. Wicks do not count. Entry at that candle's close.
Stop: the other side of the reference candle; if the reference candle is wider than 1%, 1% from entry instead.
Target: 1% from entry. No trailing.
One trade per stock, at most 2 a day, no new entries from 15:00, square off at 15:15.

meta.name: OHL opening breakout
meta.summary: Buy gap-up stocks whose open stays the day's low (sell gap-down stocks whose open stays the high) when they break their first-15-minute range in NIFTY's direction, 09:30-09:45 only.
rules: Filters: price ₹100-5,000; previous-day range above 1% of its close.
09:16 - tag stocks with open = low (within 0.06%) and a gap up as possible LONG; open = high and a gap down as possible SHORT.
09:16-09:30 - drop a stock as soon as its open stops being the day's low (high).
09:30-09:45 - LONG if NIFTY is above its open and a 1-minute candle closes above the stock's 09:15-09:30 high; SHORT if NIFTY is below its open and a candle closes below that low.
Stop = day low (LONG) / day high (SHORT). Target = 2× the risk.
At most 2 trades a day, biggest gap first. Square off at 15:15.

meta.name: VWAP + RSI momentum
meta.summary: Buy when a 1-minute candle closes back above VWAP on a volume surge with RSI in the 40-70 zone; stop 2×ATR, target 4×ATR, exit early on RSI above 70 or a close below VWAP.
rules: Watch 2 stocks: widest previous-day range %, closed above previous-day VWAP (approximation of the bot's pre-market score).
From 09:30 to 15:00, on each 1-minute close: previous close at or below VWAP and this close above it (crossover).
Not consolidating: fewer than 4 of the last 5 closes within 0.5% of VWAP. (On real 1-minute data this blocks almost every crossover - a candle crossing VWAP is nearly always close to it.)
Volume of this candle at least 1.5× the average of the previous 20 candles.
RSI(14) between 40 and 70.
Stop = entry - 2×ATR(14), target = entry + 4×ATR(14), both on 1-minute candles.
Exit early when RSI goes above 70 or a candle closes below VWAP. Square off at 15:15.
Re-entry allowed after an exit; at most 5 trades a day.
